semantics.rust_signature: fn vander_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, input: &Tensor, columns: Option<usize>, increasing: bool, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Tensor, ElementwiseRuntimeError>
semantics.shape_rule: rank-one length M input returns [M,N], where omitted N equals M and zero N is valid
semantics.dtype_rule: preserves canonical floating dtype; unrepresentable float8 powers fail typed
semantics.accumulation_dtype: f32 for the certified VJP and JVP
semantics.numeric_rule: columns contain powers N-1 through zero by default or zero through N-1 when increasing; x to power zero is one
semantics.tolerance: exact powi and canonical scalar-codec conversion; f32 gradients use fixed order
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded output intervals, during upload, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: input gradient sums output_gradient times exponent times input^(exponent-1) over columns
semantics.jvp_rule: each output tangent is exponent times input^(exponent-1) times input_tangent
